title: Efficient DNA Extraction from Cytogenetic Suspensions
author: Geórgia iz Monteiro Sant'ana-Arruda

steps.title: Homogenize fixed suspensions
steps.instruction: Homogenize the cytogenetic suspensions fixed in Carnoy’s solution (methanol and acetic acid 3:1).

steps.title: Transfer sample to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 150 µL of the homogenized suspension into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge first spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 8,000 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant and evaporate
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and place the tube in an incubator at 37 °C for 45 minutes, or until the fixative odor disappears.

steps.title: Add extraction buffer and proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 440 µL of extraction buffer (prepared from 8 mL NaCl 5 M, 1 mL Tris‑HCl 1 M pH 8.0, 400 µL EDTA 0.5 M pH 8.0, 20 mL SDS 10 %, and 70.6 mL ultrapure water to a final volume of 100 mL) and 16 µL of proteinase K (10 mg/mL) to the tube.

steps.title: Vortex and incubate
steps.instruction: Vortex briefly, then incubate the tube in a water bath at 55 °C for 1 hour 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add NaCl and vortex
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of NaCl 5 M, vortex for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 10 minutes; then transfer 500 µL of the supernatant to a newly labeled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of ice‑cold 100 % isopropanol to the transferred supernatant and mix by gentle inversion.

steps.title: Pellet DNA and discard solvent
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 10 minutes, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with 300 µL of ice‑cold 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10,000 rpm for 5 minutes, discard the supernatant, and allow the pellet to air‑dry.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried pellet in 30 µL of autoclaved Milli‑Q water.
